title: Diagnostic Suspicion of Primitive Syndrome Sjögren's : Brest Cohort
brief_summary: This study aims to evaluate the diagnosis performance of several item used for the classification, the diagnosis and the prognostic of pSS (primary Sjogren syndrome)
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with suspected pSS underwent a standardised evaluation

Exclusion Criteria:

* Opposition of patient
study_population: Patients with suspected pSS underwent a standardised evaluation
